notes: The item-folder page uses the same ChecklistActionIcons registry as the popup.
Current and archived file names are the visible open controls; redundant open/download action buttons are not rendered.
Archive permanent deletion retains the existing administrator-only backend contract.
Folder assets use the 7.2.1 cache version.
Stage 7.1.4.5 uses one real SVG path for the U+21BB-shaped replacement icon in every folder replacement control.
Stage 7.1.4.5 restores the exact previously approved U+21BB-derived SVG silhouette and reduces only its thickness with a 0.30 SVG morphology erosion.
Stage 7.2.1 makes upload, replacement and current-file deletion read-only when the folder page has no active edit-session ID.
Stage 7.2.1 sends requireEditSession with every folder document mutation so the backend cannot fall back to a nontransactional request.
Stage 7.2.2 requires an active edit session for administrator archive-version deletion.
Stage 7.2.2 stages archive files in the edit-session stash: explicit Cancel restores them, while commit permanently removes them.
Stage 7.2.3 routes folder uploads through the shared popup queue when the opener is available and limits the standalone one-item fallback queue to one active upload.
Stage 7.2.3 refreshes the active edit-session ID for each folder upload attempt and marks transient failures for automatic retry by the shared manager.
Stage 8.4.2 hides disabled/unknown local-only mirror badges; the disabled Yandex button remains the sole unavailable-state indicator.
Stage 8.4.4 aligns archive size, upload date, uploader and action cells to the current-file table columns and removes local-only archive badges.
Stage 8.5.1 makes current and archived file names clickable in the item-folder interface without exposing copy-link controls or technical URLs.
Stage 8.5.1.1 removes redundant Open and Download buttons from current and archive rows while retaining clickable names, delete controls and backend file routes.
Stage 8.8 enables the folder bell when current documents and an active edit-session are available.
Stage 8.8 uses the same notification-draft-ui.js module in popup and folder windows.
Folder URLs carry the active session actor identity; backend ownership checks remain authoritative.
Stage 8.9 exposes the same global assignment-part suggestions in the item-folder notification form.
New assignment-part values are stored globally by the backend when a draft is saved.
Stage 8.10 loads the same Bitrix employee picker in item-folder windows.
Cached employee search and manual fallback are shared with the popup notification form.
Stage 8.11 loads the same external-contractor and CRM-company picker in item-folder windows.
Stage 8.12 resolves the project object responsible user as curator for external recipients and retains manual fallback.
Stage 8.14 displays the ten most recent assignments for each current file series in the item folder.
Stage 8.15 exposes the same manual retry-only-failed control in item-folder assignment history.
Bitrix hotfix 8.15.1 keeps the folder notification bell visible but disabled and hides all non-error Yandex synchronization text.
Stage 8.15.4 publishes throttled click, key, input, change, drag, drop, touch and scroll activity from item-folder windows to the parent popup inactivity timer.
Stage 8.15.5 makes the folder back button call the opener navigation API and falls back to a stage-and-item popup URL if the opener cannot be restored.
